We need to produce a tool call. Need to embed the slab CIF and adsorbate CIF strings. They are large; we can include them as raw strings in JSON. Ensure proper escaping. Use triple quotes? JSON string must escape newlines and quotes. We'll embed as a single string with newline characters escaped as \n. Could be lengthy but okay.

We have slab_cif content from earlier result. Let's capture it. It starts with "# generated using pymatgen\ndata_Cu2O\n_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M   'P 1'\n..." up to the end of the snippet. We'll include full content.

Adsorbate_cif content from second read.

Site list is [1.3577499999999996, 4.07325, 6.073250000000001].

Now call add_adsorbate_to_slab_text.
